// `npx @noctcore/harness lint-meta --registry <this file>` imports THIS module and
// nothing else, then runs every rule it exports. The rule files beside it are
// VERBATIM copies of the ones in this repo — only their extension is pinned to
// .mts (unconditionally an ES module, whatever this repo's package.json says).
// The runner strips their TypeScript types as it loads them (Node >= 22.18).
import type { IMetaRule } from '@noctcore/harness';

// tools/lint-meta/rules/no-todo-comments.ts
import * as rule0 from './rules/no-todo-comments.mts';

/** A structurally rule-shaped value: an `id` string and a `run` function. */
function isRule(value: unknown): value is IMetaRule {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false;
  const rule = value as { id?: unknown; run?: unknown };
  return typeof rule.id === 'string' && typeof rule.run === 'function';
}

/** Every rule a module exports — under any name, as an array, or as the default. */
function rulesOf(mod: unknown): IMetaRule[] {
  if (typeof mod !== 'object' || mod === null) return [];
  const found: IMetaRule[] = [];
  for (const value of Object.values(mod)) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) found.push(...value.filter(isRule));
    else if (isRule(value)) found.push(value);
  }
  return found;
}

export const META_RULES: IMetaRule[] = [
  rule0,
].flatMap(rulesOf);
